bridge.stage-records.says: The Bridge makes the pod's records, with their versions, from what its mappings produced.

bridge.stage-mapping.says: The Bridge runs the adapter's mappings over the source record's facts to produce the pod's facts.

bridge.stage-index.says: The Bridge builds a lookup index of the source facts for its compiled queries.

bridge.stage-lift.says: The Bridge lifts the source record into facts.

bridge.stage-documenttable.says: The Bridge builds the table of documents that the source record contains.

bridge.stage-serialising.says: The Bridge writes its result out as text.

bridge.stage-summary.says: The Bridge totals what it converted.

bridge.stage-dataset.says: The Bridge sets up the facts its queries will read.

bridge.stage-detect.says: The Bridge recognises what kind of record this is.

bridge.query-detect.rq.says: The query that recognises what kind of record this is.
